Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:
We accept returns for any Dermalogica.com purchase for any reason within 30 days of your order date. The return process must be initiated within those 30 days to receive a refund.
New or gently used items in original packaging are eligible. Items that are heavily used, nearly empty, damaged from personal use, or tampered with are not refundable.
Certain items are final sale and cannot be returned: partial kits or gift sets, free samples, gifts with purchase, and rewards items.
To return, use our online returns center to generate a prepaid UPS label, repackage your products with the packing slip, and ship via UPS. Once we receive your return at our warehouse, we will process your refund or replacement.
You do not pay return shipping, handling, or restocking fees when you follow our return process.
If you paid with Afterpay or Klarna, returns still follow our return policy; you can also review their own refund/return terms on their respective sites.
If you decide not to keep an order that has already been processed and shipped, you can still use our return center to send it back for a full refund of all items marked for return.
Returning a product or canceling an order will reverse or decrease any loyalty points earned from that purchase, and may adjust your rewards tier accordingly.
